transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I just feel worn out all the time, I guess. Even after a full night in bed, it's like my body is made of sandbags. Just getting through my workday or... folding laundry... it takes everything I have right now.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?

Yeah, I suppose so. Um... most days I just wake up with this... heavy, flat feeling in my chest. Sometimes I just sit at the kitchen table for a long time, staring out at the yard, and... I don't know, it just feels like there's no good version of the future coming.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like, or has that changed recently?

Not really, no. I mean... I used to make time for things. Hiking, yoga... working in my garden. I liked taking bird photos, too. But... I don't know. Lately I just let the camera sit in the closet. I keep canceling on things. It just... doesn't feel worth the effort right now.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or ending your life?

I... I don't know. Not exactly. I mean, I haven't made a plan or anything. But... sometimes, late at night, I just... I catch myself thinking that maybe my husband would be better off without me. It just... it keeps coming back, and... I guess it scares me a little.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... I guess this part... the feeling so heavy and tired all the time... it's been most days for... maybe the past two months?
Have you been feeling anxious or nervous a lot lately?
Um... no, I don't think so. Not really nervous. Just... mostly just what I mentioned. Just tired.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or the opposite, feeling restless and fidgety?

I guess... maybe a little slow. I didn't really notice it at first, but my husband pointed it out. He said I've been moving around the house like I'm underwater. And... I don't know, if he asks me something simple, it just... takes me a while to answer him. The words just come out really slowly, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think my weight has changed much.
Are there any activities that you still find yourself looking forward to or enjoying, even if it's just a little bit?

Um... no. Not really. I used to do things... like hiking, or yoga. I liked my garden, and taking pictures of birds. But... I don't know. Lately I just keep canceling if I make plans. My camera's just been sitting in the closet. It just... none of it really feels worth the effort right now.
You mentioned earlier that you've stopped enjoying things like hiking, yoga, and gardening. Is there anything at all that you still find some interest in or look forward to?
No. Not really. I just... I don't care about much of anything right now.
Do you often feel guilty or blame yourself for things?

Um... yeah. I guess I do. 

I just... I don't know. I keep thinking about our mortgage. I keep replaying that decision in my head, over and over. I just feel like I was really selfish... and reckless. Like I put our whole household at risk. 

My husband keeps reminding me that we made the decision together, but... I just... yeah. I blame myself.
Have you experienced any periods of even slight improvement in your mood over the past two months?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. It's just... pretty much been like this the whole time.
Are there any small pleasures in life, like tasting favorite foods or enjoying a warm bath, that you still find enjoyable?

Um... no. Not really. 

Like I said before about the hiking and my garden... I just don't do any of it anymore. I used to take bird photos, too, but... my camera is just sitting in the closet. It's just... none of it feels worth the effort right now. Even the small things.
Have you experienced any strange or unusual thoughts, like hearing voices or seeing things that aren't there?
Um... no. I haven't experienced anything like that. Just... just my own thoughts.
Are there any activities, no matter how small, that you still find pleasure in?

Um... I think I just said this, but... no. Like I mentioned with the hiking and the garden... I used to make time for yoga, too. But lately I just keep canceling. None of it really feels worth the effort anymore.
Are there any activities that give you even a small amount of pleasure?

I... didn't we just cover this? 

No. Like I keep saying... the hiking, the yoga, my garden, taking those bird photos... I just keep canceling everything, or letting my camera sit in the closet. None of it feels worth the effort. I don't really know what else to tell you.
Have you been feeling fidgety or restless?

Not really restless, no. It's... kind of the opposite, actually. My husband says I move around the house like I'm underwater. And... sometimes when he asks me a simple question, it just takes me a while to answer. Like the words just come out so slowly.
Have you ever thought about how you would end your life if you decided to go through with it?

No... I don't have a plan. But... late at night, I do catch myself thinking that my husband might just be better off without me. I haven't figured out how I would do it, but... the thought just keeps coming back. It scares me a little, honestly.
Have you had any days in the past two months where you felt okay, or were you feeling down or empty every single day?
I don't know... I guess there haven't really been any okay days. It's just... this heavy, exhausted feeling. Most days, anyway. And it's been like that for... about two months now.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people cannot?
No. I haven't experienced anything like that.
